about: FDA Complete Response Letters that companies announced themselves, January 2024 on: one record per announcement, each with the company's own dated press release, stock-exchange disclosure or SEC filing. announce_date is the date printed on that source; crl_date only where the source states it. Every record was re-read against its source on 2026-11-28 (red team); records without a dated primary source are left out. Facts only, not investment advice. letters is the number of Complete Response Letters the source says were issued (2 where one release covers two).
